text: Meg Mullach, also called Maug Moulach or Maggie Moloch, was a Scottish folk figure. She was a brownie, one of the household spirits that did chores for humans. Meg looked after Tullochgorm Castle, home of the Grant family. Despite a childlike look, she had a great head of hair, which earned her the nickname Hairy Meg. Some stories give her hairy hands and say she reached down chimneys to carry off children. Southern Scots told of brownies that gathered about the hearth with the family. A brownie served without pay. When a farmer found Meg would work for free, he dismissed his hired workers. The farmer then offered Meg a wage. She vanished at once, for the tradition of laying a brownie forbids payment.
objective: Document Meg Mullach, the Scottish brownie of Tullochgorm Castle.
